objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-boot-or-logon-autostart-execution-in-startup-folder
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of files in the Windows %startup% folder, a common persistence technique. It leverages the Endpoint.Filesystem data model to identify file creation events in this specific directory. This activity is significant because adversaries often use the startup folder to ensure their malicious code executes automatically upon system boot or user logon.
